mascot.source: Hermes Agent assets/nous-girl-white (MIT, (c) 2025 Nous Research); keep attribution
mascot.mood_rule: loading -> scan; count == 0 -> happy; count > 6 or oldest_hours > 72 -> worried; else calm
mascot.ramp_rule: ping-pong along the mood's stops, never a full rainbow; dense glyphs @#%* at full colour, others mixed 30% toward white

events.joy: card answered OK: wink + hop, heart burst, XP+1, sfx ok
events.new: new item arrived: talk + hop, sfx warn
events.err: source/answer error: blink + shake, magenta tint, sfx err
events.pat: user pokes the pet: sfx ok

mascot.static_when: FX off or reduced-motion: one still idle frame, no particles

sfx.origin: sample-exact port of x55_pocket.py _tone/_seq/_env (v2 levels); X55 is the source of truth

logo.status: NOT FINAL. Eight of Wands composition, tourmaline (violet/cyan/mint) +/- stibnite. Do not ship any logo or icon until this field says FINAL.

field.what: ASCII contour map of drifting gaussian hills (port of X55 draw_ascii_field)
field.glyph: sign change across a level: horizontal '-', vertical '|', both '+'

layers.fx: top tint violet 7%, bottom tint teal, scanlines 1px every 4px; see .ub-fx in unbl0ck.css
layers.grain: noise tile 256px, opacity .07, overlay, steps(6) 0.9s jitter
layers.fx_off: field static (one trace), no grain, no glitch layers, ticker wraps static

components.corners: 22px steel L-brackets 2px thick, 12px in from each screen corner
components.eyebrow: Share Tech Mono 14px, letter-spacing .14em, label colour, '// A / B · C' syntax
components.ticks: four 14x3 bars, gap 6: cyan, magenta, amber, green; sit above the eyebrow
components.wordmark: ANSI-shadow ASCII UNBL0CK (zero), white face + steel shadow, cyan copy -1.5px and magenta copy +1.5px; glitch 5.2s steps(1): 88-94% slice/jolt; HERMES watermark behind
components.tagline: Rajdhani 500, muted, ends with amber block cursor blinking 1.06s
components.tile: panel bg, 1px steel_dark, 10px chamfers top-left + bottom-right; value mono 26px cyan (warn amber, ok green); label mono 12px .14em label colour
components.card: 1px steel frame (frame = 1px padding on a steel fill, panel inside), 18px chamfers top-right + bottom-left; 52px index box on base, 12px top-left chamfer, mono 20px cyan (chat items green); title Rajdhani 700 22px uppercase; age mono 14px dim (warn amber, stale magenta); meta mono 13.5px dim uppercase with cyan em; ask Rajdhani 500 18px muted, clamps with fade; frame turns amber on hover/focus, green when done
components.button: 40px tall, padding 0 18px, 10px chamfers top-left + bottom-right, Rajdhani 700 16px uppercase .08em; default panel2 fill + steel border (hover cyan); primary amber fill, #05070a text, ONE per card; ghost dim text no border; disabled .55; focus 2px amber outline offset 2
components.key_chip: 20x20, base fill, amber mono 13px glyph, 5px top-left chamfer; shows the hardware/keyboard key for the action, sits left of the button label
components.ticker: 30px strip, steel_dark rules top/bottom, mono label colour, cyan em, amber b, scrolls translateX(-50%) loop, edge mask
components.hazard: 6px stripe, repeating 135deg hazard 8px / clear 8px; section divider
components.section_head: eyebrow + count + 1px steel_dark rule to the edge
components.pet_shell: chamfered panel holding the mascot; status bar 'NOUS // <MOOD>' amber, hearts magenta, 'XP nn' amber
components.input: base fill, 1px steel; Rajdhani 500 17px; focus amber border + 1px amber glow
components.empty_state: panel box, steel_dark border: green mono '.14em' label + muted 20px line

motion.card_in: 420ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), from x-14 opacity 0, overshoot +2, stagger 55ms per index
motion.done: '■ UNBL0CKED' green mono 26px .3em over the card, 500ms steps(4) letter-spacing 1.2em→.3em, then card leaves
motion.reduced_motion: all animation and transitions off; mascot one still idle frame
